chunks: And a few of the later ones

key_terms.الآخِرِينَ: The later ones / The subsequent group

ai.seo_question: Who are the 'few of the later ones' in Surah Al-Waqi'ah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase highlights the rarity of the 'Sahib al-Mash'amah' (Those of the Left Hand), emphasizing that while the majority may be misguided, the true believers who attain salvation are few. This scarcity underscores the spiritual rigor required for success and serves as a warning against complacency in religious practice. The concept is often linked to the idea that true faith requires both knowledge and action, distinguishing the elect from the general populace.
